records.key_findings: The production emit_signal.py is an LLM/news sentiment classifier without explicit price target/horizon or market-structure features; latest score 44 is fallback 0 blended with news_score 88 after missing GitHub Models token and Groq 429, confidence 0. The designated signal_history file is empty while the accuracy artifact claims 1683 checked/45.9%, not reproducible from current main. Separate July HRM ledger has 45 all-NULL records and degraded sentiment; HRM confidence is agreement×convergence, not calibrated probability, and is not integrated. Knowledge Signal Cycle is a manual contents:write direct-main writer not covered by PR #1379. CoinDesk reports broad crypto deleveraging concurrent with Nasdaq weakness, confounding Binance-only event attribution.
